summary: Iteration 7 full verification. Backend: 10/11 new tests pass in test_iteration6_v2.py. CRITICAL BUG found — GET /api/activity does NOT implement the `before` cursor parameter required by the spec; the endpoint signature (server.py:742) only takes `since` and `limit`. Frontend ActivityPage sends `before` but it is silently ignored, so the 'Load older' button, once items > 50, will re-return the same newest page instead of older rows. Regression: 26/26 of test_iteration5 + test_iteration4 still green. Frontend: Activity nav link + /activity page load and render 30 grouped-by-day items correctly; MealPlannerCard → Templates modal → create → apply → meal created end-to-end works (28 day×meal-type apply slots shown); CheckoutMode renders SwipeRow wrappers with checkout-item-wrap-{id} test_ids; zero Radix DialogDescription a11y warnings (previous iteration's warnings are fully cleared).

critical.issue: Missing `before` cursor query param. server.py line 742 signature is `list_activity(request, since, limit)` — no `before`. Spec requires: returns items with created_at < before. Fix: add `before: Optional[str] = None` param, and in the query builder add `q['created_at'] = {'$lt': before}` (merging with existing $gt when both present). Test test_activity_before_cursor_pagination confirms first-page/second-page overlap because cursor is ignored.

minor.issue: Still uses bare `except Exception: pass`. Carried from prior iteration.
No validation that end_date >= start_date. Carried.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend correctly sends ?before=<iso> but backend ignores it, so clicking Load older will duplicate already-shown items (or hasMore turns false after first page if < 50 items). Strictly a backend bug, but user-visible in the frontend.

action_items: [HIGH] Add `before: Optional[str] = None` to GET /api/activity and merge into query: if before: q.setdefault('created_at', {})['$lt'] = before. One-line fix in server.py around line 742.
critical_code_review_comments: Meal templates CRUD is clean, correctly scoped by family_id, idempotent delete (second DELETE → 404 as expected), and apply endpoint copies name+ingredients+notes from template to Meal and logs activity with '(from template)' suffix — verified.
api.js `activity.list(params={})` signature is backwards-compatible with the dashboard poller that still calls activity.list({since: lastSeenTs}) — no regression in dashboard activity toast stream.
MealTemplatesModal UX: 28 apply slots (7 days × 4 meal types) rendered with deterministic testids `apply-tpl-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{meal_type}`. Good for automation.
CheckoutMode SwipeRow wires onTouchStart/Move/End to the inner button[data-testid=checkout-item-{id}]; tap (click) handler preserved. Wrapper uses data-testid=checkout-item-wrap-{id} as spec'd.
Radix DialogDescription audit is complete — zero missing-aria-describedby warnings observed across Activity, MealTemplatesModal, and CheckoutMode modal during this run (previous iteration had 3).
ActivityPage `hasMore` turns false once data.length < 50, correctly hiding the Load older button when the first page itself is under-limit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — activity page, meal-template create+apply, checkout SwipeRow wrappers, zero Radix warnings

seed_data_creation: All test-created meal templates and meals are cleaned up in zz_cleanup. UI test created/deleted TEST_UI_Taco_Tuesday template and TEST_UI_SwipeItem shopping item.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds `before` cursor support to GET /api/activity, re-run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration6_v2.py::test_activity_before_cursor_pagination tests/test_iteration5.py tests/test_iteration4.py -v`. The full regression suite is test_iteration4.py + test_iteration5.py + test_iteration6_v2.py = 37 tests. No UI re-test needed for the fix; ActivityPage already calls the endpoint correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: During iteration-6 implementation, api.js + ActivityPage.jsx + backend server.py were changed together to support pagination, but only the `since` branch of the $gt filter was retained in backend. The new `before` parameter was added to the frontend and api.js signature but the corresponding backend parameter and $lt filter were never added. Reproduction: Call `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer test_session_1776655943013' '$URL/api/activity?limit=2'` to get newest 2, take oldest `created_at`, then call `...?before=<that>&limit=5` — response still contains the newest rows instead of rows older than the cursor. Mitigation: 2-line backend change (add param + merge into Mongo query using $lt). Test `test_activity_before_cursor_pagination` will validate.
